design_notes.status: parametric CAD only; no printed fit/stability testing
design_notes.assembly: print both panels flat; join at the central cross-slit, insert both feet into grooved base
design_notes.illumination: wrap removable 5V prewired LED seed string around silhouette and use loose reusable ties through holes; do not pinch conductors
design_notes.placement: tabletop, outside children's reach, independent of tent; no overnight unattended use
